key_concepts: Current electricity is the continuous flow of electrons through a complete circuit.
An electric circuit is a closed loop that provides a return path for current.
The main parts of an electric circuit are the conductor, source, and load.
Conductors such as wires provide the pathway for electric current.
The source such as a dry cell or battery supplies electrical energy.
The load such as a bulb indicates whether the circuit is complete.
A series circuit allows electric current to flow through only one path.
